{{Quote|My regent, we are&mdash;eh&mdash;happy to certify that all tests are positive! Prince Denid lives!|Chozz Wardle|<ref name="marvel49" />}}
'''Chozz Wardle''' was the royal [[Doctor/Legends|physician]] to the [[House of Lorac]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]]. When [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Denid]] returned to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="wotc" /> after nearly 20 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of [[Exile (punishment)|exile]], Wardle was the one to verify his identity. Although he knew that the ruling [[Regent/Legends|regent]], [[Zelor]] would be displeased with the news, he declared Denid to be the long-lost son of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Lorac]] to the royal court.<ref name="marvel49" /> In his official report, Wardle stated his opinion that Denid would make a fine king. However, shortly after submitting his official report about Denid's identity, Zelor had Wardle and his entire staff [[Death/Legends|executed]].<ref name="wotc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chozz Wardle first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 49|''Star Wars'' (1977) 49]], written by [[Mike W. Barr]] and released in [[1981]]. In the comic, Wardle was illustrated by [[Walter Simonson]]. Although Wardle goes unidentified in his original appearance, his name was given in the [[2003]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] article ''[[Velmor: Royalty and Rebellion]]''.<ref name="wotc" />
